commands: execute unless data entity @s SelectedItem.id run tag @s add AlienEvoExpansion.OffhandEquip
execute if entity @s[tag=AlienEvoExpansion.OffhandEquip] run scoreboard objectives add AEO.ArmPreference dummy
execute if entity @s[tag=AlienEvoExpansion.OffhandEquip] run scoreboard players set @s AEO.ArmPreference 2
execute if entity @s[tag=AlienEvoExpansion.OffhandEquip] run item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand from entity @s weapon.offhand
execute if entity @s[tag=AlienEvoExpansion.OffhandEquip] run item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with minecraft:air
execute if entity @s[tag=AlienEvoExpansion.OffhandEquip] run superpower add alienevoexpansion:omniverse_omnitrix_offhand_bridge @s
